judged_text: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which produces an extra page whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit. A group with exactly 50 members and limit 50 reports totalPages 2; showingLast is false on page 1 so the next link is enabled and navigates to an empty page 2 (offset clamped to user_count, server returns 0 rows), leaving the admin staring at a blank member list.

record.issue_text: [BUG] totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which produces an extra page whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit. A group with exactly 50 members and limit 50 reports totalPages 2; showingLast is false on page 1 so the next link is enabled and navigates to an empty page 2 (offset clamped to user_count, server returns 0 rows), leaving the admin staring at a blank member list.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1` (when `user_count != 0`). This overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages). As a result, on page 1 `showingLast` is false, enabling the "next" action, which sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)` (so 50) and calls `group.findMembers()`. The server (`GroupsController#members`) returns 0 members for `offset == total`, producing an empty list on the computed page 2, matching the finding.
